task_description:
# Complete Annotation System

Finish implementing the annotation layer with text labels, arrows, zone highlighting, and free-hand drawing. Annotations should be part of saved playbooks.

## Rationale
Annotation layer is partially implemented but incomplete. Coaches need to add context like 'Run here if zone defense' or highlight key areas. Essential for clear communication.

## User Stories
- As a coach, I want to add text labels explaining each player's responsibility
- As a coaching educator, I want to highlight zones to explain defensive structures
- As a team analyst, I want to annotate plays with tactical notes

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Can add text labels anywhere on field
- [ ] Can draw arrows between points
- [ ] Can highlight zones/areas with semi-transparent shapes
- [ ] Can free-hand draw on field surface
- [ ] All annotations saved with playbook
- [ ] Can delete/edit individual annotations
